channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: Defense Dept working with industry to overhaul acquisition process
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the new Business Operators for National Defense program, or BOND, has already engaged over 100 industry experts.

item.title: VA secretary reflects on Year 1: what he’s learned, what’s changing and what’s next
item.description: "From day one, we said we're going to put the veteran first in anything that we do," Doug Collins said. "I think that's made the biggest difference."

item.title: Beyond buzzwords: Using OPM’s human capital standards for federal HR modernization
item.description: Steve Krauss, a former director of the HR QSMO, explains why the “loose fit” and “tight fit” data standards are key to the entire HR modernization effort.

item.title: Congressional report recommends ‘FedRAMP’ for commercial data brokers
item.description: A new report on modernizing the Privacy Act recommends Congress take action to rein in how agencies buy personal information from private data brokers.

item.title: Millions of people can’t understand life-or-death weather alerts: GAO
item.description: "It has to be a well-coordinated approach. One of the challenges is multiple agencies are involved...everyone has to be on the same page," Cardell Johnson said.

item.title: IRS CIO says agency lost 40% of tech workers last year
item.description: The IRS moved more than 1,000 IT employees out of its tech shop. Few have been reassigned to permanent roles, but many are helping out with the filing season.

item.title: NASA hopes fuel leaks are fixed as it launches another countdown test for the Artemis II moonshot
item.description: The first fueling test was halted by the same kind of liquid hydrogen leaks that disrupted the Artemis program's first flight without anyone aboard.

item.title: NIH’s Bhattacharya will also run the CDC while Trump administration looks for a permanent director
item.description: Bhattacharya will be the third leader of the embattled CDC, the nation's top public health agency, during President Donald Trump’s second term.

item.title: Trump administration further clarifies telework expectations
item.description: Guidance from OPM and EEOC details steps agencies should take when granting, modifying or denying telework requests from federal employees with disabilities.

item.title: Feds and retirees face fresh uncertainty amid resurgent instability
item.description: "This is really stepping back closer to the spoils system...politically based enforcement of laws, politically based provision of services," John Hatton said.
